 UFC's Merab Dvalishvili Shares Bloodied Face After Being Jumped by Usman Nurmagomedov

 By  
 Hal Fish 
 Published Nov 11, 2026, 4:38 PM GMT 
 Hal is an experienced freelance sports journalist at GiveMeSport, having previously produced content for websites such as Goal , football.london , HertsLive , 90min,  The Set Pieces and many others. 
Hal picked up his MA in Sports Journalism and NCTJ qualification from St Mary's University Twickenham, Hal has since been part of Valnet since late 2021.
He started as a freelance football writer for  This Is Futbol and carried that on over to  FootballFanCast before becoming their social media editor. He now works as an editor for GiveMeSport, predominantly focusing on Premier League, Champions League, and English football.
He also helps GiveMeSport cover other major sports such as MMA, boxing, darts, tennis, and golf. Key events like the summer and winter Olympics are also highlights when they appear on the sporting calendar. 
Hal is an Arsenal and Three Lions fan, but keeps an eye on the All Blacks, his favourite rugby team, having grown up in New Zealand.

 UFC star Merab Dvalishvili has shared shocking footage of his brutal injuries after being jumped by Usman Nurmagomedov.
 Add GiveMeSport on Google 
 Add as Preferred Source 
 The Georgian, who recently took on Petr Yan in the UFC 333 co-main event but lost, was in a hotel lobby for an interview ahead of his RAF Abu Dhabi match when he claims to have been attacked on Wednesday (11 November).
 ‘The Machine’ is currently scheduled to wrestle his former UFC rival Marlon Moraes this Saturday. It's now unclear whether their match will go ahead, though, with Dvalishvili clearly sustaining a lot of damage during the alleged brawl.
 Dvalishvili Shares Aftermath of Clash With Nurmagomedov
 The 35-year-old took to social media to show the aftermath of the incident . Speaking with blood streaming down his face, Dvalishvili revealed what happened as he called out the surprise attack on him and his friend:
 “What a sneaky way, guys, just two of us came here in Abu Dhabi, and Usman Nurmagomedov and his friends came like snakes from behind, what kind of fighters are you? What kind of men are you? You came from behind, there is just two of us and you guys were prepared, what the f***?”
 While still receiving medical care, he continued: “We bleed, we fight, we work, you guys are just sneaky guys, you are not real men, what the f***, if you want to fight let’s fight, we are fighters, bro. You guys came from behind, all of your friends waiting for us in a sneaky way. I knew what kind of guys you are… We were fighting like real men, 20 guys vs just two guys, we are warriors, you are p******."
 In a caption on social media, he also added: "Was doing an interview for RAF in hotel lobby and Usman and his buddies came up from behind and started punching me and my young friend. Security was holding me - They kept kicking us when we were down like losers."
 Dvalishvili and Nurmagomedov's Ongoing Beef
 Dvalishvili and Nurmagomedov previously fought at UFC 311 in January 2025, when the Georgian scored a thrilling decision win to successfully defend his bantamweight title. The pair have had an ongoing feud since. 
 In July 2026, Dvalishvili had another clash , this time with a friend of the Russian's, which occurred at a pre-fight press conference. On the incident, Nurmagomedov later said: “How do you live with that?”
 Dvalishvili fired back: “Umar and some small people keep talking trash about me. You guys probably don’t know anything about life, but I am a man, and if you come to me, pulling me over, disrespect me, start loud talk with me in a different language, I will slap your face. Because that’s who I am. That’s how I grew up. That’s my culture and that’s what you’re going to get.
 “So it doesn’t matter if I am in U.S., if I am in Mexico, in Australia, or in my country Georgia. If you come with bad intentions, you’re going to get bad intentions.”
